name: Question 6
worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${a}_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column: 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & ∗ & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗ & 0 & ∗ \\ 9 & 0 & ∗ & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${a}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{23} & =(-1)^{2+3}{M}_{23} \\  & =-{M}_{23} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

First, to get the minor of a23, we remove the 2nd row and 3rd column:

A=[1−7∗3∗∗0∗90∗−13−5∗0]

C23=(−1)2+3M23=−M23=−|1−7390−13−50|.
